verdict.rationale: The docs show OCR output can carry confidence scores at page, block, or word granularity via the confidence_scores_granularity parameter. That gives a data engineer the raw signal to route low-confidence content. However, nothing shows the scores are calibrated or attached to structured annotation fields, and no built-in human review workflow is documented. The community user who mentions human review appears to run their own process. Missing for 10: evidence of calibration, field-level confidence on structured/annotation extractions, a native human-in-the-loop review/routing path, independent hands-on corroboration of confidence-score usefulness.
